base_url.correction: Batch API endpoints are region-specific: https://eu1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2, https://us1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2, or https://au1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2.

free_tier_limits.correction: New accounts receive $100 in credit with no card required. Service pauses when the credit is exhausted unless a payment card is added.

rate_limits.correction: Published limits include 1 batch job/second and 2 concurrent realtime sessions on Free; 10 batch jobs/second and 50 realtime sessions on Pro. Batch guidance also limits status checks to 50/second and applies a 20,000-concurrent-job backstop.

notes: The service and documentation are operational. The major defects are the obsolete unprefixed Batch host, vague/outdated free-tier wording, and the false claim that rate limits are unpublished. Current pricing was updated July 31, 2026.
